scheme_name: Registered BOC Workers in case of an Accidental Death (JKBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a nominee or dependent of a registered worker who died in an accidental death
Applicant must have worked in building or other construction work for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months
Registration of the worker is renewed annually
benefits_summary: A financial assistance of ₹4,00,000 is provided to the nominee or dependents of the deceased worker.
